summary: Gerbera is a UPnP media server that enables you to distribute digital audio and video files across a local network. It indexes your media library and streams content directly to compatible playback devices without requiring cloud intermediaries.
goodFor: It suits users who want to serve local media files to traditional hardware players like network-attached television sets or dedicated audio receivers.
watchOut: The development pace is relatively slow, and configuration usually requires editing XML files or managing a web interface rather than relying on automated setup.
deployNotes: You will typically need to mount local storage volumes into the container or host environment so the server can index your files.
